author: reek
body: A hash ring exists to spread keys over nodes, so that is what this measures. The chapter's only previous test printed a fixed string, which is why a ring that sent 993 of 1000 keys to one node survived: a function that always answers the same thing looks exactly like one that works.

author: reek
body: The counts are exact because the mixer is deterministic; the min and max lines say what the counts are FOR, so a reader can see the intent without recomputing the mixer.
